|game_text=Deploy on table. Black Sun agents are forfeit and defense value +1. Once per turn, if you just deployed an information broker, may exchange the top card of Force Pile with any one card in hand. [Reflections II] Emperor deploys -1 and moves for free. [Immune to Alter.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Information Exchange (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Information Exchange (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-d7881b2">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual26-Dark/large/informationexchange.gif</code> as published 2 December 2025: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/d7881b28d79e33541236559133b4d9583b43812d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/informationexchange.gif holotable commit d7881b2] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009031319id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual26-Dark/large/informationexchange.gif Exact archived Players Committee image].</ref>: “Deploy on table. Black Sun agents are forfeit and defense value +1. Once per turn, if you just deployed an information broker, may exchange the top card of Force Pile with any one card in hand. [Reflections II] Emperor deploys -1 and moves for free. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Information Exchange (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260428005738id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>, page 1, file created 26 December 2025: “Deploy on table. Black Sun agents are forfeit and defense value +1. Once per turn, if you just deployed an information broker, may exchange the top card of Force Pile with any one card in hand. [Reflections II] Emperor deploys -1 and moves for free. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Information Exchange (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Information Exchange”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Information Exchange (V)]] (published 2 December 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Information Exchange]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
